rationale.campaign_length: 35项J53专属定义，另有湖地共通内容。
rationale.colonization: 草原开拓存在，但不是海外殖民。
rationale.complexity: 形成、宗教、草原治理和分支战争并行。
rationale.dark_story: 灭绝分支非常黑暗，和解分支则相反。
rationale.difficulty: 形成过程和边疆战争需规划，未实机测评。
rationale.diplomacy: 半人马与南方国家有和平、附庸和战争取舍。
rationale.early_pressure: 压力取决于湖地前身及分裂局势。
rationale.magic_artifice_intensity: 神学重要，但普通火器不等于奇械术。
rationale.narrative_density: 湖地分裂、草原复兴与半人马抉择相连。
rationale.tall_play: 畜牧与水源建设必要但不以单城为中心。
rationale.trade_economy: 草地经济服务骑兵国家。
rationale.warfare: 草原骑兵和后期南征是主循环。

identity.appearance: 湖地联邦分裂路线形成国，非1444固定持地国家
identity.formation_scope: 合格湖地成员在分裂体系下触发J53形成效果，改Tag换树；年份不固定

national_ideas.scope_note: 国家传统、七项国家理念与野心；不含可选理念组、种族/政府加成。多套候选与条件分别列示，不视为同时叠加；形成时是否接受新理念由实际事件/决议与玩家选择决定。

description.text: 虽然现代的特里温湖地人可能看起来不是这样，但扎巴特拉尔人曾经是众多的游牧群体，生活在整个草原上。虽然许多技术后来都被遗忘了，但恢复它们的能力却一直在我们的血液中徘徊。随着那些具有冒险精神的人加入我们，在平原上打造一个新的身份，成为奥拉恰夫人，这片土地再次属于我们只是时间问题。
description.text_en: While the modern Triunics may appear otherwise, the Zabatlari were once numerous nomadic groups that lived across the entire steppe. While many techniques have since been forgotten, the capacity to recover them has lingered in our blood. With those adventurous at heart joining us to forge a new identity on the plains as the Orachav, it is only a matter of time before the lands belong to us again.

description.text:
虽然湖泊女神与特里温湖地人密切相关，但她们并不是我们民族最早崇拜的神。在一望无际的草原上，其废墟中刻着我们祖先的仪式，其中最高的是对塔括舒尔的仪式，塔括舒尔是我们头顶上的太阳，是所有生命和文明的源泉。
虽然我们是在母亲尤克勒的波浪后面等待时机，但在塔括舒尔的光辉下，我们要直面我们的命运。
description.text_en:
While the goddesses of the lakes are closely associated with the Triunics, they were not the first gods worshiped by our people. Inscribed on ruins across the endless grasslands are the rites of our forefathers, and highest among them are those towards Taqoshur, the sun above our heads and the source of all life and civilization.
While it was behind mother Yukel's waves that we bided our time, it is under Taqoshur's glow that we face our destiny head-on.

description.text: 虽然勒洛亚勒的森林、山丘和城市抑制了骑兵的行动，但开阔的草原需要只有坐骑才能提供的自由行动。虽然我们还没有掌握这种形式，但你只需看看一群半人马就能了解机动性在战斗中的作用。让你的敌人被包围就等于在战斗开始前就有效地赢得了战斗，而保持从前进中的敌人手中逃走的能力则确保了完全失败是不可能的。不要让奥拉恰夫的脚踩在地上作战，这样他们将永远不会被征服。
description.text_en: While the forests, hills, and cities of Leloyal inhibited the movements of cavalry, the open steppe demands the free movement only a mount can provide. While we have yet to master this form, you need only look to a pack of centaurs to learn the role of mobility in combat. To have your enemy surrounded is to have effectively won a battle before it has even begun, and to retain the ability to flee from an advancing foe ensures total defeat is an impossibility. Let no Orachav fight with their feet upon the ground, and they will never be vanquished.

description.text: 当我们从那些夺走我们祖先土地的人手中夺回我们自己的土地时，我们周围山区的健壮居民也开始这样做。塔约戈尔，一个合适的神，体现了这种保护我们的土地不受威胁的愿望，并从我们的土地上获得丰厚的财富。任何与邪恶和灾难势力作斗争的人都是奥拉恰夫的朋友，任何熟练的战士都能在我们中间找到一个家。
description.text_en: As we reclaim our own ancestral lands from those that took it from us, the stout inhabitants of the mountains surrounding us have begun to do the same. Tayoghor, a god of such proportions, embodies this desire to protect our lands from that which threaten it, and to enrich ourselves from the bounty of our land. Any who fight against the forces of evil and disaster are a friend to the Orachav, and any skilled warrior can find a home among us.

description.text: 当一个孤独的奥拉恰夫旅行时，知道携带多少食物可能是一个生死攸关的问题，因为最近的补给可能在几天之外。当一个团体旅行时，可以带上畜群，但在匆忙的战争中，这种奢侈是无法承受的。虽然马匹可以在一瞬间低下脖子享用青草，但我们的人必须为数周的旅行做好准备，并知道如何准备。
description.text_en: When a lone Orachav travels, knowing how much food to carry can be a matter of life and death, for the nearest supplies could be days away. When a group travels, herd animals may be brought along, but in the haste of war this luxury cannot be afforded. While horses can tilt their necks and feast upon grass at a moment's notice, our men must be prepared for weeks of travel and know how to prepare for it.

description.text: 虽然身体强壮的半人马一直是激烈战争的主宰，但火器的引入使我们重新获得了优势。他们在战场上的冲锋陷阵意义不大，因为我们可以从远处将他们击毙，而我们可以在自己的骏马上保持这一优势。虽然有些人已经学会了在马背上开弓，但枪支的效力将使这种技术成倍增长。
description.text_en: While the physically stronger centaur has been the master of hectic warfare, the introduction of the firearm has returned the advantage to us. Their charges across the field of battle mean little now that we can drop them dead from a distance, which we can maintain upon our own steeds. While some have learned to fire a bow from atop a horse, the effectiveness of the gun will multiply that technique tenfold.

description.text: 耶路什告诉我们，虽然草原的土地可能是一致的，但保卫它所需的战争却不是这样。当地形不受限制时，朋友和敌人的阵型也一样。我们同伴的布达克大队的信号弹和烟雾，半人马的塔儿颜突击军的无休止的骚扰，或者食人魔的武装伊赫洛姆格马尔狂战士大军，我们必须准备好适应和征服他们。
description.text_en: Yerush teaches us that while the lands of the steppe may be consistent, the wars needed to defend it are anything but. When terrain is not limited, the formations of friend and foe alike. The flares and smoke of our fellow men's Budakh Brigades, the endless harassment of a centaur Taryean Raider party, or the Ogrish bulk of an Armed Iklomgemar, we must be prepared to adapt to and vanquish them all.

description.text: 当大入侵到达我们的城市时，半人马遇到了他们的对手，我们的城市建在一个他们无法攀登的巨大高原上。即使面对这样的障碍，他们仍然顽强地坚持着，在我们的塔楼下留下成千上万被我们的弓箭手杀死的战士遗体。多亏了他们的顽固，我们才有了充足的肥料。
description.text_en: When the Great Incursion reached our city the centaurs met their match, our city being built atop a great plateau that they could not scale. Even faced with such an obstacle they, perhaps admirably, persisted, leaving thousands of their warriors slain by our archers below our towers. Thanks to their stubbornness we have plenty of materiel to fertilize our fields with.

description.text: 天际城是由一个神秘的术士建立的，他被称为「地平线之人」，他提升了我们城市赖以生存的高原，并建造了许多我们称之为家的塔。其中许多塔楼仍鲜有人使用，这使我们能够根据需要将其转化为其他用途。
description.text_en: Yikashlay was founded by a mysterious sorcerer known as "He of the Horizon", who raised the plateau our city rests upon and constructing many of the towers our people call home. Quite a few of the towers are still barely used, allowing us to convert them to whatever purposes we require.

description.text: 半人马一定是想把我们饿出高塔。当我们开始在我们最高的塔上种植农产品时，他们一定哭了。
description.text_en: The centaur hordes must have been attempting to starve us out of our towers. How they must have wept when we simply began growing our produce from our tallest towers.

description.text: 有人会说我们的达官贵人「粗俗」，但正是他们根本受不了善意的玩笑。
description.text_en: There are those that would call our dignitaries "vulgar" and "crude", but it is they that simply cannot take a goodnatured joke.

effects.display: 从侮辱得到的力量投射：+1
effects.label_zh: 从侮辱得到的力量投射

description.text: 当我们的高原上没有足够的空间来建造塔楼时，我们高耸的大厦里满是工场和住宅，我们开始向城市地下的岩石扩张，在这块岩石上建立一个繁华的市场。
description.text_en: As our plateau runs out of space to construct towers upon and our standing edifices fill with workshops and residences, we have taken to expanding into the rock beneath our city, establishing a bustling market carved within the very bedrock.

description.text: 我们的城市提供了一种无与伦比的视角，在夜晚可以一览无余地看到天上的星星，我们的学者对此进行了细致的跟踪和记录。
description.text_en: Our city offers a view like none other, granting an unobstructed view of the stars above at night, which our scholars have taken to meticulously tracking and charting.

description.text: 我们的塔楼已经满了，如果我们再挖下去，下面的土地就有倒塌的危险。我们只有一种扩张的方式：到我们塔楼上的云彩中。
description.text_en: Our towers are full, and the land beneath risks collapsing should we carve any further. We have only one way to expand; to the very clouds above our towers.

description.text: 在大入侵期间，我们城市的西部被半人马部落彻底摧毁了。要使这个地区恢复繁荣，必须做很多工作。
description.text_en: The western half of our city was utterly devastated by the centaur hordes during the Great Incursion. Much work must be done to return prosperity to this district.

description.text: 索夫科克亚是尤克勒库尔湖上最常用的商船，因其宽敞的货舱能够装载贸易货物和人员而备受推崇。
description.text_en: The Sovkokeya is the most commonly used trade ship in Lake Yukelqur, prized for its spacious hold capable of carrying trade goods and men alike.

description.text: 为了防止走私者堵塞我们的运河，我们组织了一支海军陆战队在河岸巡逻。在战争时期，我们可以派这些海军陆战队增援我们的海军。
description.text_en: To keep smugglers from choking our canal we've organized a militia of marines to patrol the banks. In times of war we can assign these marines to bolster our naval forces.

description.text: 雇佣兵事务办公室是一个致力于确保我们雇佣兵尽其所能完成工作的组织，并把他们的收入用于改善他们的设备，而不是用于喝酒和嫖妓。虽然有些人可能认为这是过度的，我们的预算肯定赞赏它。
description.text_en: The O.M.A. is an organization dedicated to ensuring our hired blades are doing the jobs they were hired for to the best of their ability, and spend their earnings on improving their equipment rather than on drink and women. While some may see this as overbearing our budget certainly appreciates it.

description.text: 随着我们城市的扩张，我们已经开始建造与横跨运河的大桥相连的高塔，我们的富人已经打包，搬到这个高耸的地区，许多商人选择花很长一段时间的海滨假期在美化的天空步道的设施内。
description.text_en: As our city expands we have taken to constructing great towers linked with bridges crossing over the canal, our wealthy have packed up and moved to this soaring district and many merchants choose to spend long periods of shore leave within the establishments gracing the Sky Walk.

description.text: 当我们的城市在上升时，那些被留在下面的人，毫不留情地在黑暗中，在我们的地下城市被污染的废墟中辛苦工作。虽然他们可能是粗野的野兽，但他们确实给我们的民兵带来了某种技能。
description.text_en: While our city soars, those left below, quite literally in the dark, toil within the polluted detritus of our undercity. While they may be rowdy brutes, they do bring a certain set of skills to our militia.

description.text: 为了引导船只通过我们现在漆黑的运河，光明使者们手持火把沿路行进。他们在地下城中充当我们的执法者，让来访的商人看不到那些人渣和暴民。
description.text_en: To guide ships through our now darkened canal, the Lightbearers carry torches along the way. They act as our enforcers within the undercity, keeping the scum and rabble out of sight from visiting traders.

description.text: 第一城是传奇雇佣兵团焦尔吉克乌特的驻地。最初是被派去与半人马战斗的岛上的被流放者，自我们的城市建立以来，他们已经成为一支纪律严明、受人尊敬的半人马杀戮者的力量。
description.text_en: Buruvaqoyla plays host to the legendary mercenary band, the Jolgik Uts. Originally exiles from the islands sent to die fighting the centaurs, since our city's founding they've become a disciplined and respected force of centaur slayers.

description.text: 每个人都必须准备好拿起武器，抵御每年折磨我们腹地的半人马的袭击。这就是部落之地附近的生活。
description.text_en: Every man must be ready to take up arms and fend off the centaur raids that plague our hinterlands on a yearly basis. Such is life so close to the hordelands.

description.text: 在联邦的支持下，我们终于可以越过国界进入我们祖先的故土，夺回我们祖先在半人马逼近时被迫逃离的土地。
description.text_en: With the backing of the Federation, we can finally extend our reach beyond our borders into the old lands of our forefathers, taking back the lands our ancestors were forced to flee when the centaurs bore down on them.

description.text: 当一个人只有片刻的休息来欣赏他们周围的土地，他们可以充分认识到我们发现自己在宁静和舒适的景观。如果我们一定要跌倒，我们再也想象不到比这更美丽的地方了。
description.text_en: When one has but a moment's rest to admire the land around them, they can fully recognize the serene and comforting landscape we find ourselves in. If we must fall, we cannot imagine a more scenic place to do so.

description.text: 建立我们城市的焦尔吉克乌特是由传说中的第一城女士领导的。她的出身是个谜，有人说她以前是北方城市的强盗，也有人说她是被剥夺继承权的公主。无论她的真实背景是什么，我们都决心确保她的梦想永不破灭。
description.text_en: The Jolgik Uts that founded our city were led by the legendary Lady of Buruvaqoyla. Her origins are a mystery, some claim she was but a former bandit from the northern cities, others suggest that she was a disinherited princess. Whatever her background truly was, we are determined to ensure her dream never falls.

description.text: 我们终于有机会让可怕的半人马屈服于他们长久以来给我们带来的恐惧，在他们的家中猎杀他们，把他们的村庄夷为平地，就像他们多次在我们的内陆地区所做的那样。
description.text_en: We finally have the opportunity to subject the dreaded centaurs to the horrors they've inflicted upon us for so long, hunting them in their homes and razing their villages as they did so many times to our hinterlands.

description.text: 禁忌平原广袤无垠，草和沙似乎一望无际。在我们无畏的焦尔吉克乌特的带领下，我们的军队已经学会了在这片土地上旅行。
description.text_en: The Forbidden Plains are vast, a seemingly endless expanse of grass and sand. Led by our fearless Jolgik Uts, our armies have learned to navigate this land like no other.

player_overview.avoid_if: 只想平稳统一湖地联邦，或不愿处理边疆灭绝路线与复杂形成条件的玩家。
player_overview.how_it_plays: 先完成分裂形成与草原立足，中期治理土地并重建信仰，后期靠骑兵火器远征、处理半人马和南方国家。
player_overview.overview: 伟大骑手不是开局国家，而是湖地联邦分裂后可能诞生的草原共和国。你要让畜牧和边疆制度供养骑兵，再以新的神学、骑兵火器和南方远征扩大国家。它最尖锐的分岔在半人马问题上：结束世代仇杀，或把逃亡者赶尽杀绝。这个选择比单纯的战斗力更能决定国家是什么样子。
player_overview.recommended_for: 喜欢骑兵共和国、湖地替代路线和有重大分支抉择的玩家。
signature_features: 湖地联邦分裂形成的骑手共和国，不是正常联邦统一路线。
畜牧、草原信仰与骑兵火器共同塑造军事国家。
对半人马的和解或灭绝分支令人格与结局大幅变化。
player_overview.tagline: 带湖地骑手重返草原，决定以和解还是毁灭结束旧日仇恨。

reasons: 少见的湖地分裂形成国
半人马路线带来显著价值分歧
warnings: 形成门槛和换树时点可能困惑
黑暗分支包含灭绝叙事

positive_indicators: 事件文本给出结束世代仇杀的和解选项
草原畜牧与水源治理服务国民生存
任务叙事承认阳光惠及不同族群
values.rationale: 草原生活、共和国与和平抉择有公共利益；另一可选分支明确追杀逃亡半人马，严重否定其人格。综合分只作分支未定时的暂定位置，不把灭绝路线说成必然。骑兵征服本身不计善恶。
red_flags: 可选路线明确提出继续消灭逃亡半人马
边疆战争易把敌对群体整体物化
